# Quaternius assets (CC0 1.0)

By Quaternius (https://quaternius.com), CC0 1.0 — see the licence files next to the assets.

- `village/` — Medieval Village MegaKit [Standard] FBX pieces (via github.com/kierbob/godotmovementshooter)
  with the kit's trim-sheet textures (via github.com/kirbycope/godot-npc-village).
- `humans/` — built by `tools/build_humans` from Universal Base Characters, Modular Character
  Outfits – Fantasy and Universal Animation Library 1 & 2 (via github.com/kirbycope/godot-npc-village).
  The build merges outfit + head + hair, recolours hair and the undead, adds weapon grip joints and
  renames/time-warps animation clips.
